  1. Cluster Kubernetes 1.28 is below the supported range 1.29–1.33 of v1.18.0 [imp-7e9a11c2834d]

     v1.18.0 requires Kubernetes 1.29–1.33; the cluster runs 1.28, which is also already outside the source release's range (v1.17.0): the exclusion is pre-existing — this upgrade does not cause it, but the upgrade is still blocked. Plan the cluster upgrade at or above 1.29 before upgrading v1.18.0. The chart's kubeVersion constraint itself admits 1.28; the narrower supported range is the project's tested-matrix statement (Helm will not refuse the install).
